rationale: Both complete-record long-history shift diagnostics fail after averaging the two fits, and already admitted native high-budget references will resolve the missing same-fit rule-change comparison. Admit six frozen native second-fit learning-curve points: artifact, sparse and complete evidence at 64 and 256 episodes with 2048 labels. These complete the moderate-budget repeated-fit comparison against the admitted 8192/32768-label and shorter-history references, testing training-data limitation versus history-related decoder failure. They use only registered fits and lineages, with no new settings, extra worlds or sign-selected seeds. Restore one measured day of useful work and preserve confirmation priority, reserve and cutoff.
